judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and a failing acceptance test (`src/orchestration/afterModelResponseUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing the feature in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is completely untouched, the newly added acceptance tests will fail when `npm test` is run. Furthermore, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate kept the old under-counting description text instead of replacing it, merely appending a `validated by` link that contradicts the sentence it is attached to. The `CHANGELOG.md` entry and the `afterModelResponse` signature update (`totalUsage`) are also completely missing.
